message: The other day, I was rummaging through my old storage bins and came across my family’s emergency go-bags. I remember the day I insisted we pack them, and my kids rolled their eyes, thinking I was being overly cautious. Well, wouldn’t you know it, last week we had a little scare with a storm warning, and suddenly those bags became the star of the show! 😄 It felt good to know we were ready, and I couldn’t help but chuckle a bit at my ‘I told you so’ moment. It’s funny how preparedness can turn a little anxiety into a lot of peace of mind, isn’t it?
